structured_output.what_is_happening: "Deed Estate" (DEED) is a tokenized rental-property vault project on Robinhood Chain, an Arbitrum-based L2 where memecoin trading is currently hot. Its official site (deed.estate) lists only one contract, 0x5e55f18453545d0d4314c5106a2d8db934298e95 on Robinhood Chain, launched through the Pons launchpad. DexScreener links that EVM contract to deed.estate and @deedestate. The Solana token FK7z…x66L copies the name, ticker and tagline ("Built on Robinhood"). About 2h18m after launch it shows $30.9M in 24h volume on roughly $190k of liquidity (about 160x turnover), a 1,783% price gain, and around $1.07M market cap. That volume is about 4x the canonical Robinhood token's. DexScreener shows no profile, website or socials for it. The only social link is a GeckoTerminal handle, which anyone can set. On-chain flow is extremely lopsided. GeckoTerminal counts 2,035 unique buyers but only 53 unique sellers over 6h, and just 12 sellers made about 4,297 sell transactions in the last hour. The top 10 holders own 94.8% of supply. RugCheck flags most LP as unlocked. A second Solana copy with the same name (EATx…, about $546k market cap) already exists. And dozens of DEED clones are on Robinhood Chain itself.

narrative.description: A real-estate rental-income vault on Robinhood Chain ('Rent is due. Shouldn't you get a cut?'). It rides the wider Robinhood Chain memecoin/RWA wave, which crypto.news and others report is pulling volume away from Solana in September 2026.
narrative.why_spreading: The Robinhood Chain launch of DEED went viral. Its canonical token has about $8M in 24h volume, a ~$1.9M FDV and spawned many clones. Solana traders are copying the ticker to trade that attention on their own chain. The story belongs to the Robinhood Chain token, not to this Solana copy.

token_connection.why_this_token: Its only connection is the copied name, ticker and description. The official site lists only the Robinhood Chain contract, and the project's Telegram does not mention this Solana contract. The Telegram's latest post even warns that 'Neither the Deed Estate protocol nor $DEED is live yet. Be careful.' This Solana token is simply the most liquid of the cross-chain copies.
token_connection.competing_tokens: Canonical: Robinhood Chain 0x5E55f18453545d0D4314C5106a2D8Db934298E95 (~$1.9M FDV, deed.estate/@deedestate linked). Solana copy EATxpD3TXmY7PPN2SEWF2YPW1p9Dds66aJfVP1cPF5dP (~$546k market cap). Also more than 10 Robinhood Chain clones, including 0x55d5… linked to deedestate.com/@DeedEstaterh.

authenticity.evidence: Over 6h there were 2,035 unique buyers but only 53 unique sellers. Over the last hour, 12 sellers made about 4,297 sell transactions. Volume of $30.9M against about $190k of liquidity points to volume bots or wash trading, or a small set of wallets feeding supply to many small buyers. The top 10 holders own 94.8% of supply. There is no DexScreener profile and no social post about this Solana contract anywhere I could find.
authenticity.uncertainty: GeckoTerminal's seller counts may miss some wallet types, and the top-10 figure may include pool accounts. I could not read X, so there may be real Solana KOL or community activity I didn't see.

structural_risks: Top 10 holders own 94.8% of supply (the figure may include the pool)
Most LP is unlocked (RugCheck 'danger' flag), and 0% is locked on one of the top markets
Very few unique sellers, which suggests a concentrated supply is being distributed
It is not the canonical token, and a second Solana copy is competing for the same attention
The official project can deny or ignore Solana copies at any time
Turnover near 160x liquidity looks like bot-inflated volume

structured_output.counterargument: Cross-chain copies of viral tickers sometimes keep running on their own when Solana traders can't easily reach the new chain. Solana copies of Robinhood Chain memes are an established pattern. This copy leads the Solana side by liquidity and volume and has about 2,000 buyers. Mint and freeze authorities are renounced. If the canonical Robinhood DEED keeps climbing, the Solana copy could follow it as a proxy.
unknowns: Actual X/Twitter discussion of the Solana contract (X was not readable)
Who the top-10 holder wallets are and whether they are linked to the creator
Whether the official project will acknowledge or disown the Solana copies
How much of the volume is bot/wash trading versus real trading
Why a Meteora DBC pair exists (the launch route is unclear)

source_coverage.notes: Fetching x.com returned HTTP 402, and searches for the contract returned nothing. The public Telegram t.me/s/deedestate (1.59K subscribers) does not mention the Solana contract. deed.estate lists only the Robinhood Chain contract. News coverage is about the Robinhood Chain memecoin wave in general, not this token.

structured_output.thesis: This is a ticker hijack. The DEED narrative is real and belongs to the Robinhood Chain token that deed.estate links to. The Solana token is an unaffiliated copy with extreme holder concentration, unlocked LP and a buyer/seller pattern that suggests bots or distribution. The attention here is borrowed and probably manufactured, so it is likely to fade.
